title: Make policy handoff admit-only and worker-leased
summary: Agora handoff endpoint made strictly admit-only (process_immediately deprecated and removed from inline execution). Candidates are admitted in STATUS_PROPOSED and processed exclusively via worker-leased claims.

acceptance_verification.handoff_admit_only: Verified that /api/policy-learning/agora-handoff creates candidates in STATUS_PROPOSED without inline processing.
acceptance_verification.worker_leased_processing: Verified that worker/claim, worker/process, and worker/restart handle claims, execution, and expired lease recovery.
acceptance_verification.fail_closed_dataset_authority: Verified product mode reads tenant-scoped DatasetVersion authority and never uses seed fallback.
acceptance_verification.runtime_effect_none: Verified candidates carry explicit runtime_effect=none and /promote always returns HTTP 409.
